issues.description: The script uses GM_xmlhttpRequest to fetch search result pages from greasyfork.org and sleazyfork.org. No evidence of third-party or external data transmission beyond these domains.
issues.location: GM_xmlhttpRequest usage in search result merging logic
issues.recommendation: Ensure only necessary data is fetched and not user-sensitive information. No user data is sent to third-party servers.

issues.description: The script reads and writes to localStorage as a fallback for storing user preferences if GM storage is unavailable.
issues.recommendation: No sensitive data is stored. Acceptable for this use case.

issues.description: The script requests several GM_* permissions, including GM_notification, GM_registerMenuCommand, GM_setValue, GM_getValue, but not all are used in the code.
issues.recommendation: Remove unused @grant permissions to reduce attack surface.

script_name: Greasyfork Search with Sleazyfork Results include
summary: The script merges search results from greasyfork.org and sleazyfork.org, and does not transmit user data to third-party servers. It does not collect sensitive information, execute remote code, or use obfuscation. The main issue is overprovisioned permissions in the metadata block. Overall, the script is considered low risk.
